segments.mn121:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
segments.mn121:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn121:3.1: “ekamidaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati nagarakaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
segments.mn121:3.2: Tattha me, bhante, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.mn121:3.4: Kacci metaṃ, bhante, sussutaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritan”ti?
segments.mn121:3.5: “Taggha te etaṃ, ānanda, sussutaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ.
segments.mn121:3.6: Pubbepāhaṃ [pubbecāhaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], ānanda, etarahipi [etarahi ca (sabbattha)] suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi.
segments.mn121:4.1: Seyyathāpi, ānanda, ayaṃ migāramātupāsādo suñño hatthigavassavaḷavena, suñño jātarūparajatena, suñño itthipurisasannipātena atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭicca ekattaṃ;
segments.mn121:4.3: evameva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā gāmasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā manussasaññaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:4.4: Tassa araññasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:4.6: ‘ye assu darathā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:4.8: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ gāmasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:4.10: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’”ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:4.11: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā manussasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā araññasaññaṃ, pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:5.2: Tassa pathavīsaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:5.3: Seyyathāpi, ānanda, āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ;
segments.mn121:5.4: evameva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ imissā pathaviyā ukkūlavikkūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ [sabbaṃ (ka.)] amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:5.5: Tassa pathavīsaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:5.7: ‘ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā araññasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:5.9: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ araññasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:5.11: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:5.12: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā araññasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ, ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:6.2: Tassa ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:6.4: ‘ye assu darathā araññasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:6.6: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ araññasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ pathavīsaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:6.8: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:6.9: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ, viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:7.2: Tassa viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:7.4: ‘ye assu darathā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:7.6: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ pathavīsaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:7.8: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:7.9: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ, ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:8.2: Tassa ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:8.4: ‘ye assu darathā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:8.6: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:8.8: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:8.9: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda bhikkhu amanasikaritvā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:9.2: Tassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:9.4: ‘ye assu darathā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:9.6: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan’ti.
segments.mn121:9.8: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:9.9: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ, animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:10.2: Tassa animitte cetosamādhimhi cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:10.4: ‘ye assu darathā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – imameva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā’ti.
segments.mn121:10.6: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññāyā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – imameva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā’ti.
segments.mn121:10.8: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:10.9: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:11.1: “Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ, amanasikaritvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ, animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.
segments.mn121:11.2: Tassa animitte cetosamādhimhi cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
segments.mn121:11.5: ‘Yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:11.6: Tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
segments.mn121:11.8: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:12.2: ‘ye assu darathā kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā bhavāsavaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, ye assu darathā avijjāsavaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi, atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ – imameva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā’ti.
segments.mn121:12.4: So ‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ kāmāsavenā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ bhavāsavenā’ti pajānāti,‘suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ avijjāsavenā’ti pajānāti,‘atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ – imameva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā’ti.
segments.mn121:12.6: Iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti.
segments.mn121:12.7: Evampissa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā paramānuttarā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
segments.mn121:13.1: “Yepi hi keci, ānanda, atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu, sabbe te imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu.
segments.mn121:13.2: Yepi [ye (sī. pī.)] hi keci, ānanda, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissanti, sabbe te imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissanti.
segments.mn121:13.3: Yepi [ye (sī. pī.)] hi keci, ānanda, etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharanti, sabbe te imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharanti.
segments.mn121:13.4: Tasmātiha, ānanda,‘parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissāmā’ti [viharissāmīti (pī. ka.)]– evañhi vo [te (ka.)], ānanda, sikkhitabban”ti.
segments.mn121:13.7: Attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Tattha ekamidanti thero kira bhagavato vattaṃ katvā attano divāṭṭhānaṃ gantvā kālaparicchedaṃ katvā nibbānārammaṇaṃ suññatāphalasamāpattiṃ appetvā nisinno yathāparicchedena vuṭṭhāsi.

“na kho pana sakkā dhurena dhuraṃ paharantena viya gantvā ‘suññatākathaṃ me, bhante, kathethā’ti bhagavantaṃ vattuṃ, handāhaṃ yaṃ me bhagavā nagarakaṃ upanissāya viharanto ekaṃ kathaṃ kathesi, taṃ sāremi, evaṃ me bhagavā suññatākathaṃ kathessatī”ti dasabalaṃ sārento ekamidantiādimāha.

Kaccimetaṃ, bhanteti thero ekapade ṭhatvā saṭṭhipadasahassāni uggahetvā dhāretuṃ samattho, kiṃ so “suññatāvihārenā”ti ekaṃ padaṃ dhāretuṃ na sakkhissati, sotukāmena pana jānantena viya pucchituṃ na vaṭṭati, pākaṭaṃ katvā vitthāriyamānaṃ suññatākathaṃ sotukāmo ajānanto viya evamāha.
Eko ajānantopi jānanto viya hoti, thero evarūpaṃ kohaññaṃ kiṃ karissati, attano jānanaṭṭhānepi bhagavato apacitiṃ dassetvā “kaccimetan”tiādimāha.
“ānando suññatākathaṃ sotukāmo, eko pana sotuṃ sakkoti, na uggahetuṃ, eko sotumpi uggahetumpi sakkoti, na kathetuṃ, ānando pana sotumpi sakkoti uggahetumpi kathetumpi,(kathemissa) suññatākathan”ti.

Tattha suñño hatthigavāssavaḷavenāti tattha kaṭṭharūpapotthakarūpacittarūpavasena katā hatthiādayo atthi, vessavaṇamandhātādīnaṃ ṭhitaṭṭhāne cittakammavasena katampi, ratanaparikkhatānaṃ vātapānadvārabandhamañcapīṭhādīnaṃ vasena saṇṭhitampi, jiṇṇapaṭisaṅkharaṇatthaṃ ṭhapitampi jātarūparajataṃ atthi, kaṭṭharūpādivasena katā dhammasavanapañhapucchanādivasena āgacchantā ca itthipurisāpi atthi, tasmā na so tehi suñño.
Indriyabaddhānaṃ saviññāṇakānaṃ hatthiādīnaṃ, icchiticchitakkhaṇe paribhuñjitabbassa jātarūparajatassa, nibaddhavāsaṃ vasantānaṃ itthipurisānañca abhāvaṃ sandhāyetaṃ vuttaṃ.

Bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭiccāti bhikkhūsu hi piṇḍāya paviṭṭhesupi vihārabhattaṃ sādiyantehi bhikkhūhi ceva gilānagilānupaṭṭhākauddesacīvarakammapasutādīhi ca bhikkhūhi so asuññova hoti, iti niccampi bhikkhūnaṃ atthitāya evamāha.
Gāmasaññanti gāmoti pavattavasena vā kilesavasena vā uppannaṃ gāmasaññaṃ.
Araññasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattanti idaṃ araññaṃ, ayaṃ rukkho, ayaṃ pabbato, ayaṃ nīlobhāso vanasaṇḍoti evaṃ ekaṃ araññaṃyeva paṭicca araññasaññaṃ manasi karoti.
Ye assu darathāti ye ca pavattadarathā vā kilesadarathā vā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca bhaveyyuṃ, te idha araññasaññāya na santi.
Atthi cevāyanti ayaṃ pana ekaṃ araññasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjamānā pavattadarathamattā atthi.
Yañhi kho tattha na hotīti yaṃ migāramātupāsāde hatthiādayo viya imissā araññasaññāya gāmasaññāmanussasaññāvasena uppajjamānaṃ pavattadarathakilesadarathajātaṃ, taṃ na hoti.
Yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhanti yaṃ migāramātupāsāde bhikkhusaṅgho viya tattha araññasaññāya pavattadarathamattaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
Taṃ santamidaṃ atthīti pajānātīti taṃ vijjamānameva “atthi idan”ti pajānāti, suññatāvakkantīti suññatānibbatti.

“manussasaññāya gāmasaññaṃ nivattetvā, araññasaññāya manussasaññaṃ, pathavīsaññāya araññasaññaṃ, ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya pathavīsaññaṃ … pe … nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññāya ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ, vipassanāya nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ, maggena vipassanaṃ nivattetvā anupubbena accantasuññataṃ nāma dassessāmī”ti.
Tattha pathavīsaññanti kasmā araññasaññaṃ pahāya pathavīsaññaṃ manasi karoti?
Yathā hi purisassa ramaṇīyaṃ khettaṭṭhānaṃ disvā –

“idha vuttā sāliādayo suṭṭhu sampajjissanti, mahālābhaṃ labhissāmī”ti sattakkhattumpi khettaṭṭhānaṃ olokentassa sāliādayo na sampajjanteva, sace pana taṃ ṭhānaṃ vihatakhāṇukakaṇṭakaṃ katvā kasitvā vapati, evaṃ sante sampajjanti, evameva –

“idaṃ araññaṃ, ayaṃ rukkho, ayaṃ pabbato, ayaṃ nīlobhāso vanasaṇḍo”ti sacepi sattakkhattuṃ araññasaññaṃ manasi karoti, nevūpacāraṃ na samādhiṃ pāpuṇāti, pathavīsaññāya panassa dhuvasevanaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ pathavīkasiṇaṃ parikammaṃ katvā jhānāni nibbattetvā jhānapadaṭṭhānampi vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā sakkā arahattaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.
Tasmā araññasaññaṃ pahāya pathavīsaññaṃ manasi karoti.
Idāni yasmiṃ pathavīkasiṇe so pathavīsaññī hoti, tassa opammadassanatthaṃ seyyathāpītiādimāha.
Aññesaṃ pana gunnaṃ gaṇḍāpi honti pahārāpi.
Tesañhi cammaṃ pasāriyamānaṃ nibbalikaṃ na hoti, usabhassa lakkhaṇasampannatāya te dosā natthi.
Ūnakasatasaṅkuvihatañhi nibbalikaṃ na hoti, saṅkusatena vihataṃ bheritalaṃ viya nibbalikaṃ hoti.
Pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattanti kasiṇapathaviyaṃyeva paṭicca sambhūtaṃ ekaṃ saññaṃ manasi karoti.
Darathamattāti ito paṭṭhāya sabbavāresu pavattadarathavasena darathamattā veditabbā.
Jīvitapaccayāti yāva jīvitindriyānaṃ pavatti, tāva jīvitapaccayā pavattadarathamattā atthīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Kāmāsavaṃ paṭiccāti kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca uppajjanapavattadarathā idha na santi, ariyamagge ceva ariyaphale ca natthīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Iti manussasaññāya gāmasaññaṃ nivattetvā … pe … maggena vipassanaṃ nivattetvā anupubbena accantasuññatā nāma dassitā hoti.
Anāgatepi, etarahipi buddhabuddhasāvakasaṅkhātā samaṇabrāhmaṇā imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramaṃ anuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu viharissanti viharanti ca, tasmā.
Thero pana bhagavato vattakaraṇatthaṃ kālaparicchedaṃ karoti,“ettake kāle vītivatte idaṃ nāma bhagavato kātabban”ti.
So tatthakaṃyeva samāpattiṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāti, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ “kālaparicchedaṃ katvā”ti.
Suññatāphalasamāpattiṃ appetvāti etena itare,“na sotāpannasakadāgāmī phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjantī”ti vadanti, taṃ vādaṃ paṭisedheti.
Suññatoti attasuññato ca niccasuññato ca saṅkhārā upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
Sekkhānañhi suññatāpaṭivedho pādesiko subhasukhasaññānaṃ appahīnattā, tasmā so thero suññatākathaṃ sotukāmo jāto.
Dhurena dhuraṃ paharantena viyāti rathadhurena rathadhuraṃ paharantena viya katvā ujukameva suññatā … pe … vatthuṃ na sakkāti yojanā.
Pubbepāhantiādinā bhagavā paṭhamabodhiyampi attano suññatāvihārabāhullaṃ pakāsetīti dassento “paṭhamabodhiyampī”ti āha.
Sotunti aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā sotumpi.
Uggahetumpiti yathābhūtaṃ dhammaṃ dhāraṇaparipucchāparicayavasena hadayena uggahitaṃ suvaṇṇabhājane pakkhittasīhavasā viya avinaṭṭhe kātumpi.

Kaṭṭharūpapotthakarūpacittarūpavasena katāti thambhādīsu uttiritvā katānaṃ kaṭṭharūpānaṃ, niyyūhādīsu paṭimāvasena racitānaṃ potthakarūpānaṃ, sittipasse cittakammavasena viracitānaṃ cittarūpānañca katā niṭṭhapitā.
Jiṇṇapaṭisaṅkharaṇatthanti jiṇṇānaṃ niyyūhakūṭāgārapāsādāvayavānaṃ abhisaṅkharaṇatthāya tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ṭhāne rahassasaññāṇena ṭhapitaṃ.
Ekabhāvaṃ ekaṃ asuññatanti paccatte upayogavacanaṃ, ekattaṃ eko asuññatoti attho.
Eseva nayoti iminā “pavattavasena vā kilesavasena vā uppannaṃ manussasaññan”ti imamatthaṃ atidisati.
Ettha ca yathā gāmaggahaṇena gharādisaññā saṅgahitā, evaṃ manussaggahaṇena itthipurisādisaññā saṅgahitā.
Yasmā rukkhādike paṭicca araññasaññā tattha pabbatavanasaṇḍādayo antogadhā, tasmā tattha vijjamānampi taṃ vibhāgaṃ aggahetvā ekaṃ araññaṃyeva paṭicca araññasaññaṃ manasi karoti.
Dutiyapadeti “ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭiccā”ti imasmiṃ pade.
“nāyaṃ pubbe viya oḷārikā, dhammappavattī”ti saṅkhāradassanadarathānaṃ sukhumatā sallahukatā ca caritatthāti āha “pavattadarathamattā atthī”ti.
Yaṃ kilesadarathajātaṃ, taṃ imissā darathasaññāya na hotīti yojanā.
Pavattadarathamattaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, vijjamānameva atthi idanti pajānātīti yojanā.
Suññatā sahacaritañhi suññaṃ, idha suññatāti vuttā.
Araññasaññāya visesānadhigamanatoti,“araññaṃ araññan”ti manasikārena jhānādivisesassa adhigamābhāvato,“pathavī”ti manasikārena visesādhigamanato.
Idāni tamevatthaṃ upamāya vibhāvetuṃ “yathā hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Suṭṭhu vihatanti yathā valīnaṃ lesopi na hoti, evaṃ sammadeva ākoṭitaṃ.
Nadītaḷākādīnaṃ tīrappadeso udakassa ākaraṭṭhena kūlaṃ, unnatabhāvato uggataṃ kūlaṃ viyāti ukkūlaṃ, bhūmiyā uccaṭṭhānaṃ.
